articles.title: Nifela and the promise that built PepegaX
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Every great team has an origin story, and [PepegaX](#/team/pepegax)'s begins not with a trophy but with a promise made in frustration. That promise belonged to [Nifela](#/player/nifela), an American in-game leader whose journey to the top of the Bot Pro League was anything but a straight line.

Through 2021 he was a wanderer, passing from Unorthodox to Team Elegy to Team Ragtag as he searched for a group that could hold together. The search paid off when he joined the original [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) roster and, later that year, lifted Bot Pro League Minor 8. For a young leader still finding his feet it was the perfect early reward, and it looked like the start of something.

The momentum did not last. [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) could not build on that Minor, and as the wins dried up [Nifela](#/player/nifela) grew convinced the roster needed changing to reach the next level. Their leader, [Sakami](#/player/sakami), did not want to make those moves, at least not then. The disagreement hardened into a real rift, and in 2022, rather than stay in a project he no longer believed in, he walked away.

He did not leave quietly. On his way out he made a vow, that he would build a team better than [Sakami](#/player/sakami)'s [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable). It was a bold thing to promise, and it gave him a purpose. In a twist that still colours the tale, [Sakami](#/player/sakami) would eventually make the very changes [Nifela](#/player/nifela) had argued for, yet [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) have never won an S-Tier title to this day.

What followed was another spell in the wilderness. He tried his luck with Marauders of Oblivion, then Eternal Requiem, then Octagon, and none of them clicked. It was not until the BPL Legends Stage in 2023 that the pieces finally fell into place, when the group that would become [PepegaX](#/team/pepegax) came together and, for the first time since Unforgettable, the wandering leader had a home worth fighting for. Around himself he built a team with real firepower, including the rising [yuuki_ps](#/player/yuuki-ps).

Through it all, [Nifela](#/player/nifela) proved that a caller does not have to sacrifice his own output. From the leader's chair he has piled up 895 kills and 163 MVP rounds, a remarkable tally for a player whose first job is to run the team. He is living proof that the man calling the rounds can still be the one winning them.

Even then the trophy did not come easily. For two long years [PepegaX](#/team/pepegax) chased a title that kept slipping away, until at last it arrived in the most dramatic fashion possible. Their miracle run at the Audax Esse 2025 Invitational turned the promise into history. The nomad who could not find a home had built one from nothing, and he had built it into a champion. The argument, the vow, the years of searching, all of it led to that moment. The rest, as they say, is history.

articles.title: Sketch and the Aimpunch dynasty that defined an era
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Sketch](#/player/sketch) may not be the name on everyone's lips today, but there was a time when he stood at the very centre of the Bot Pro League, and no honest account of the league's history can be written without him. As the leader of [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch), he did not just win games. He built a dynasty, and dynasties are how legacies are made.

From late August 2022 to early September 2024, [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) were the team everyone else measured themselves against. Across that run [Sketch](#/player/sketch) carried them to multiple S-Tier titles and a Major, a haul that still leaves them among the most decorated teams the league has ever produced. When the biggest events came around, [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) were rarely just competing. More often than not, they were the ones lifting the trophy.

The foundation of it all was a decision that took real conviction. In 2022, with the roster already competitive, [Sketch](#/player/sketch) chose to let go of [xmeijixx](#/player/xmeijixx) and [yuuki_ps](#/player/yuuki-ps) and bring in [Chiai Fujikawa](#/player/chiai-fujikawa) and [balililmao](#/player/balililmao). It was the kind of call that can define a captain, and this one defined [Sketch](#/player/sketch). Up to that point he had been the one calling the rounds himself, but he handed the in-game leader role to [Chiai Fujikawa](#/player/chiai-fujikawa) and trusted the new voice to run the team, freeing himself to focus purely on fragging. The new-look [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) clicked almost immediately, and the pieces he assembled became the core of a championship machine.

What followed was a stretch of dominance that few teams in any era have matched. [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) reeled off 18 straight match wins across S-Tier events, an unbeaten run that seemed like it might never end. It finally came undone against [99Lives](#/team/99lives) at Bot Pro Cup 2023, a result that sent shockwaves through the scene. But a great team is measured by how it responds, and [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) responded in the most emphatic way possible. They fought back through the loser's stage, refused to drop another series, and stormed all the way to the title anyway. The team that beat them still watched them lift the trophy.

Through all of it, [Sketch](#/player/sketch) was the constant. With the calling now in [Chiai Fujikawa](#/player/chiai-fujikawa)'s hands, he was free to do what he had always done best, and that was frag. In his prime he was the most prolific AWPer the league had ever seen, the sniper opponents built their plans around, and his tally of MVP performances speaks to someone who consistently showed up when the rounds mattered most. Giving up the leadership did not shrink his impact. If anything, it sharpened it.

The players he moved on from went on to write their own stories too, which only underlines that his 2022 gamble was about fit and vision rather than a lack of talent. [yuuki_ps](#/player/yuuki-ps) in particular has thrived since, starring for [PepegaX](#/team/pepegax) and adding a title of her own with their Audax Esse 2025 triumph. That her path led to more silverware makes the crossroads of 2022 all the more remarkable, because both teams to emerge from that split found success.

[Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) are quieter now, and [Sketch](#/player/sketch) no longer sits atop the leaderboards the way he once did. In recent days he has even stepped away from the sniper role that made his name, transitioning to rifling and handing the AWP to his longtime teammate [mond33__](#/player/mond33), settling into more of a support player who creates space and sets up his teammates rather than the one closing out the highlight rounds. But legacies are not measured by a single season. They are measured by the banners that stay hung long after the run ends, by the rivals who still speak your name, and by the standard you set for everyone who came after. By that measure, [Sketch](#/player/sketch) and the [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) dynasty are permanent. He carried a team to the mountaintop and kept them there, and in the story of the Bot Pro League, that chapter belongs to him.

articles.title: Aspire look beyond Singapore, add Mikuryne and Chisa_Scarlett
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Aspire](#/team/aspire) have reshaped their roster with two signings, moving on from [Stylus](#/player/stylus) and [Moira](#/player/moira) and bringing in free agents [Chisa_Scarlett](#/player/chisa-scarlett) and [Mikuryne](#/player/mikuryne). Both departing players become free agents, and the changes take effect immediately.

The move is a response to a rough season. [Aspire](#/team/aspire) have struggled to string wins together, with the whole roster hovering around a 35% map win rate, and the team sat near the bottom of the pro standings. Something had to give, and the front office chose to target the two spots where the numbers were weakest.

[Stylus](#/player/stylus) leaves after a long run as the team's AWPer, but his form had fallen away, with a 0.74 K/D over the season that made him the roster's biggest liability in the duel. [Moira](#/player/moira), a veteran rifler with years of history in the scene, departs after posting a sub-1.0 K/D of her own. Both had been part of the core since the [Aspire](#/team/aspire) project came together, and their exits mark the end of an era for the team.

In come two riflers who bring immediate upside. [Chisa_Scarlett](#/player/chisa-scarlett) arrives as the standout Singaporean free agent on the market, carrying a 1.11 K/D and a winning record over her recent maps. [Mikuryne](#/player/mikuryne) is the bigger statement, the highest-rated free agent available anywhere in the league, and crucially she is Indonesian rather than Singaporean.

That signing is a notable shift. [Aspire](#/team/aspire) had always fielded an all-Singaporean five, and [Mikuryne](#/player/mikuryne) is the first player from outside the country to join the roster. It is a clear signal that the team is willing to look beyond its borders and prioritise raw ability over a purely national identity if it means winning more games.

The surviving core of [Hanarisu](#/player/hanarisu), [TuxedoCat](#/player/tuxedocat) and [caarrietan](#/player/caarrietan) stays in place to anchor the new-look team, with [Hanarisu](#/player/hanarisu) remaining a fixture of the lineup. On paper the new five is a meaningful step up, and [Aspire](#/team/aspire) will be hoping the fresh blood delivers a stronger, more competitive version of the team in the events ahead.

articles.title: Astral Bloom and Lunar Cadence complete three-player swap
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Astral Bloom](#/team/astral-bloom) have overhauled their roster in a three-for-three trade with Lunar Cadence, a move aimed at reversing a dismal run that has left them at the foot of the standings.

Out go riflers [Eris Suzukami](#/player/eris-suzukami) and [Tsumugi Kokage](#/player/tsumugi-kokage), along with AWPer [Shiranami Ramune](#/player/shiranami-ramune), all three heading to Lunar Cadence. Coming the other way are riflers [Ginjo Saine](#/player/ginjo-saine) and [Kogara Toto](#/player/kogara-toto) and AWPer [Yumeno Akari](#/player/yumeno-akari).

The core duo of [Remia Aotsuki](#/player/remia-aotsuki) and [Tachibana Hinano](#/player/tachibana-hinano) stay put. Remia keeps the in-game leader role while Hinano remains the team's most reliable fragger, giving [Astral Bloom](#/team/astral-bloom) a familiar spine to build around.

The rebuild also keeps the org firmly Japanese. With [Tachibana Hinano](#/player/tachibana-hinano), [Ginjo Saine](#/player/ginjo-saine), [Kogara Toto](#/player/kogara-toto) and [Yumeno Akari](#/player/yumeno-akari) all flying the flag, four of the five starters are Japanese, alongside the Dutch [Remia Aotsuki](#/player/remia-aotsuki).

The incoming trio arrive as a package from Lunar Cadence, so the chemistry should already be there. On paper it is a clear upgrade in the win column, with [Ginjo Saine](#/player/ginjo-saine) and [Kogara Toto](#/player/kogara-toto) both winning more than half of their maps this season, a stark contrast to the sub-40% marks Astral Bloom had been posting.

Whether it lifts them off the bottom remains to be seen, but after a 7-18 record in maps, standing still was never an option.

articles.title: Masmark part ways with estellyy., sign HikariiFloofie
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Masmark](#/team/masmark) have made a change to their active roster, releasing AWPer [estellyy.](#/player/estellyy) and signing free-agent rifler [HikariiFloofie](#/player/hikariifloofie) in her place. The move takes effect immediately.

For much of the past year [Masmark](#/team/masmark) ran a double-AWP setup, with [estellyy.](#/player/estellyy) sharing the sniper role alongside [Xyrolizea](#/player/xyrolizea). That left the team a little light on pure rifle firepower, and this switch is aimed squarely at fixing it. [HikariiFloofie](#/player/hikariifloofie) arrives off strong recent form, posting a 64% win rate and a 1.12 K/D, and she steps straight into the rifle line next to [urnisa_](#/player/urnisa) and [kn](#/player/kn).

The change also keeps the roster tightly knit around a shared language and region. With in-game leader [XueHuaVT](#/player/xuehuavt) calling the shots and [Xyrolizea](#/player/xyrolizea) now the team's sole AWPer, [Masmark](#/team/masmark) field an all-SEA five that should communicate cleanly under pressure.

[estellyy.](#/player/estellyy) departs as a free agent after a long run with the club stretching back to 2023, a tenure that took in multiple Audax Esse Invitational campaigns. She leaves as one of Masmark's most familiar faces, and there is plenty of interest in where she lands next.

The timing is deliberate. The swap arrives midway through Bot Pro Cup 2026, giving [HikariiFloofie](#/player/hikariifloofie) a live stage to settle in and the team a chance to see whether a single-AWP, rifle-heavy look can push them up the standings.

articles.title: Team Singapore crowned BPL Nations Cup 2026 champions
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Team Singapore are the champions of the [BPL Nations Cup 2026](#/tournament/bpl-nations-cup-2026), sweeping through the bracket and dropping just a single map on their way to the title.

The run began in the Round of 16 with a clean 2-0 win over Team Vietnam. Singapore never looked troubled, setting the tone for what would become one of the most convincing title runs the Nations Cup has seen.

The Quarterfinals brought another 2-0, this time against a strong Team Taiwan. [caturteer](#/player/caturteer) and [obvMX](#/player/obvmx) led the fragging while [twentyrosie](#/player/twentyrosie) and [Aranionja](#/player/aranionja) provided the supporting firepower, and [Dirfun](#/player/dirfun) anchored the sniper role down the stretch.

In the Semifinals, Singapore met Team Indonesia, the eventual third-place finishers, and once again closed it out 2-0. The result booked their place in the final without dropping a map across the first three rounds.

The Final was the only real test. Team Korea, who had battled their way to the championship match, managed to take a map off Singapore, but it was not enough. Singapore steadied themselves and closed out a 3-1 victory to lift the trophy.

Across four rounds Singapore went 2-0, 2-0, 2-0 and 3-1, conceding just one map in the entire tournament. It is a statement result for [caturteer](#/player/caturteer), [Aranionja](#/player/aranionja), [obvMX](#/player/obvmx), [twentyrosie](#/player/twentyrosie) and [Dirfun](#/player/dirfun), and it cements Singapore right at the top of the region.

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #1 sneakyyyyy
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
The best player of 2025 won his first title at the Major, and he was the reason [Cosmos](#/team/cosmos) won it.

[sneakyyyyy](#/player/sneakyyyyy) began the year on a team that went out in the group stage of the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025), losing to [Neverland](#/team/neverland) and [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz). By June, Cosmos were sixth at the [BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025](#/tournament/BPLRR2025), beating [Artisian](#/team/artisian), [Sacred Raven](#/team/sacred-raven), DiamondOnes and [99Lives](#/team/99lives).

In October came the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLCStage25). Cosmos swept Technomancy 2-0, then won three straight deciders: 2-1 over [entity](#/team/entity), 2-1 over [Aetherline](#/team/aetherline), and 3-2 over [The Gigarage](#/team/the-gigarage) in a final that went to the fifth map. The Gigarage had not dropped a map all event. Cosmos took three from them.

An 11-4 record, the first title in Cosmos history, and the biggest one in the BPL. In a year with five different champions and no dominant team, one rifler stood above the rest when it mattered most. By December, Cosmos were second in the BPL ranking and closing on [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch), who have held the top spot since 2022.

"In March we couldn't get out of a group," sneakyyyyy said. "In October we won the Major. I don't think anybody saw that coming, except us."

**The BPL Top 20 Players of 2025**

1. [sneakyyyyy](#/player/sneakyyyyy)
2. [inaxho](#/player/inaxho)
3. [azzuto](#/player/azzuto)
4. [gigichiii_](#/player/gigichiii)
5. [kokushi_vampir](#/player/kokushi-vampir)
6. [yunaeyo](#/player/yunaeyo)
7. [mmirawr_](#/player/mmirawr)
8. [SanCtuary](#/player/sanctuary)
9. [tanykeat](#/player/tanykeat)
10. [NipNip](#/player/nipnip)
11. [EfreetsZ](#/player/efreetsz)
12. [DelphoxLuna](#/player/delphoxluna)

15. [YoJareddo](#/player/yojareddo)
16. [xJavyz](#/player/xjavyz)
17. [caturteer](#/player/caturteer)
18. [VPLH](#/player/vplh)
19. [SashimiGoesBloop](#/player/sashimigoesbloop)
20. [Xyrolizea](#/player/xyrolizea)

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #2 inaxho
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Every decider [Cosmos](#/team/cosmos) won at the 2025 Major was called by [inaxho](#/player/inaxho).

The British IGL led a team that finished 17th at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025) and sixth at the [BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025](#/tournament/BPLRR2025). At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLCStage25), they became champions. After sweeping Technomancy, Cosmos won three straight series that went the distance: [entity](#/team/entity) 2-1, [Aetherline](#/team/aetherline) 2-1, and a 3-2 final against [The Gigarage](#/team/the-gigarage), who had not lost a map all event until they met Cosmos.

The first title in Cosmos history, and the biggest one there is. By the end of the year Cosmos were the second-ranked team in the BPL, closing in on [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch).

An 11-4 record and a Major for the IGL.

"In the final we were 2-2 and I told them, one more map and we're in the history books," inaxho said. "They believed me. That's the whole job."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #3 azzuto
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[azzuto](#/player/azzuto) won the deciders that won [Cosmos](#/team/cosmos) their first title.

At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLCStage25), Cosmos swept Technomancy and then needed a third map in both the quarterfinal and the semifinal, against [entity](#/team/entity) and [Aetherline](#/team/aetherline). They won both. The final against [The Gigarage](#/team/the-gigarage), who hadn't dropped a map all event, went to a fifth map. Cosmos won that too.

Before the Major, Cosmos had been steadily improving: 17th at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025), sixth at the [BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025](#/tournament/BPLRR2025) with five wins from seven. Then they peaked at exactly the right moment.

An 11-4 record and a Major title for one of the sharpest riflers in the league.

"Three deciders in four series," azzuto said. "My heart rate still hasn't come down."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #4 gigichiii_
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[gigichiii_](#/player/gigichiii) called [The Gigarage](#/team/the-gigarage) to a perfect title run at the [BPL Legends Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLLStage23), and was #13 on our list that year. In 2025 she took them to within one map of a Major.

At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLCStage25), The Gigarage swept [New Jade](#/team/new-jade), [Artisian](#/team/artisian) and [Round Loss Bonus](#/team/round-loss-bonus) 2-0, six maps without a loss, and met [Cosmos](#/team/cosmos) in the final. It went five maps. Cosmos won the last one.

It capped a year of steady excellence: three group wins, two of them 13-0, at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025), and five wins from seven at the [BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025](#/tournament/BPLRR2025). The Australian IGL is the highest-placed player on this list from a team that didn't win the Major.

"Two years ago we were perfect at the Legends Stage," gigichiii_ said. "This year we were one map short of perfect at the Major. I'll take the progress. I won't take the result."

articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[kokushi_vampir](#/player/kokushi-vampir)'s year started with [Cosmos](#/team/cosmos) finishing 17th and ended with them as Major champions.

"From 17th to champions," kokushi_vampir said. "Somebody should write a book. Actually, don't. We're not done."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #6 yunaeyo
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[yunaeyo](#/player/yunaeyo) has been with [The Gigarage](#/team/the-gigarage) since their perfect [BPL Legends Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLLStage23) run. In 2025 the American rifler took them to a Major final.

The Gigarage arrived at the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLCStage25) in form and played like it: [New Jade](#/team/new-jade) 2-0, [Artisian](#/team/artisian) 2-0, [Round Loss Bonus](#/team/round-loss-bonus) 2-0. Six maps won, none lost. The final against [Cosmos](#/team/cosmos) went to a fifth map, and Cosmos took it.

Around the Major, The Gigarage were ninth at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025) and eighth at the [BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025](#/tournament/BPLRR2025), winning eight of eleven group and Swiss matches across the two events.

An 11-5 record and a silver medal at the biggest event of the year.

"We've won a perfect event before," yunaeyo said. "Now we need to win the important one."

articles.body:

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #8 SanCtuary
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[SanCtuary](#/player/sanctuary) was our #1 player of 2022. In 2025 he is back in the top ten, still calling for [Artisian](#/team/artisian), still with the same five players.

Artisian played four big events and won 14 series, more than all but a handful of players in the league. At the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025) they won all four group matches before a three-map quarterfinal loss to DiamondOnes. At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLCStage25) they beat [Alcheministry](#/team/alcheministry), the Reshuffle champions, 2-0 and reached the quarterfinals.

At the [BPL Legends Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLLStage25) they finished sixth with five wins, including a 22-20 overtime win over [Cyanide](#/team/cyanide) and a 13-1 win over [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch), who they had also beaten 13-7 at the [BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025](#/tournament/BPLRR2025).

A 14-7 record from one of the best IGLs the league has seen.

"Four years with the same five players," SanCtuary said. "We don't need to talk much. We still talk too much."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #9 tanykeat
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[tanykeat](#/player/tanykeat) was #7 on this list in 2021, when his [Syzygy](#/team/syzygy) team beat [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) in a winners' final and then lost the grand final to them. Four years later, he finally has a title.

It came at the [BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025](#/tournament/BPLRR2025) with [Alcheministry](#/team/alcheministry). They won six of seven maps, beating [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable), [The Gigarage](#/team/the-gigarage) 13-2, [Opal](#/team/opal), [division20](#/team/division20), [Aeternum](#/team/aeternum) and, in the match that settled first place, [entity](#/team/entity) 13-7.

Alcheministry's year also included a 22-18 overtime win over [99Lives](#/team/99lives) at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025). An 8-4 record and the first trophy of the IGL's career.

"Four years since Syzygy," tanykeat said. "I almost forgot what a final felt like. This one, I'll remember."

articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[NipNip](#/player/nipnip) called one of the two teams that took [Cosmos](#/team/cosmos) to a deciding map before the Major final.

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #11 EfreetsZ
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Two of 2025's S-Tier champions lost one map each at their title events. Both of those losses were to [Aetherline](#/team/aetherline), and [EfreetsZ](#/player/efreetsz) was there for both.

At the [BPL Challengers Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLChalS2025), Aetherline beat [Moonlit Tempo](#/team/moonlit-tempo) 13-7, the champions' only defeat. At the [BPL Legends Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLLStage25), Aetherline beat [New Jade](#/team/new-jade) 13-10, also the champions' only defeat. They also beat [Artisian](#/team/artisian) 19-16 in overtime there.

Their best result came at the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLCStage25): wins over [division20](#/team/division20) and [Masmark](#/team/masmark), both 2-1, and a semifinal that [Cosmos](#/team/cosmos) won 2-1 on their way to the title. Fourth at the Major.

An 11-6 record from a rifler who made Aetherline the team nobody wanted to face.

"We beat both champions," EfreetsZ said. "We just never got to hold a trophy ourselves. Next year."

She joined [Cosmos](#/team/cosmos) for the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLCStage25), and the rifler fitted in at once. Cosmos swept Technomancy 2-0 in the group stage. They beat [entity](#/team/entity) 2-1 in the quarterfinals and [Aetherline](#/team/aetherline) 2-1 in the semifinals. In the final against [The Gigarage](#/team/the-gigarage) they went to a fifth map and won it.

Four series, four wins, and the first title in Cosmos history, won at the biggest event of the year.

One event keeps her at #12. But no player on this list had a better debut.

"I got the call, I said yes, and then I had a Major," DelphoxLuna said. "I'm still waiting for the catch."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #13 Mike
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Mike](#/player/mike) has now made this list three times: #9 in 2021, #15 in 2024, and #13 this year. Every time, his teams have been at their best when they were written off.

In 2025 his [entity](#/team/entity) team started slowly, losing their first two group matches at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025) and going out. Three months later they were second at the [BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025](#/tournament/BPLRR2025), with six wins from seven, including a 19-17 overtime win over [Sacred Raven](#/team/sacred-raven).

At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLCStage25) they swept [The Nomads](#/team/the-nomads) and took [Cosmos](#/team/cosmos), the eventual champions, to three maps in the quarterfinals.

A 9-4 record and another year as one of the league's most trusted IGLs.

"People keep counting us out after one bad event," Mike said. "I keep counting on that."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #14 d.chong
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[d.chong](#/player/d-chong) won the first title of his career at the [BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025](#/tournament/BPLRR2025) with [Alcheministry](#/team/alcheministry).

They won six of seven maps: [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) 13-6, [The Gigarage](#/team/the-gigarage) 13-2, [Opal](#/team/opal) 13-10, [division20](#/team/division20) 13-4, [entity](#/team/entity) 13-7 in the match that decided first place, and [Aeternum](#/team/aeternum) 13-8. Only [Masmark](#/team/masmark) beat them.

Earlier in the year, at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025), Alcheministry won a 22-18 overtime marathon against [99Lives](#/team/99lives) but went out in the group stage. At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLCStage25), [Artisian](#/team/artisian) beat them in the group stage.

An 8-4 record and a trophy.

"Years of trying," d.chong said. "One title. I'll take it, and then I'll take another."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #15 YoJareddo
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[YoJareddo](#/player/yojareddo) came within one map of winning a Major.

The American rifler's [The Gigarage](#/team/the-gigarage) team didn't drop a map at the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLCStage25) until the final. They swept [New Jade](#/team/new-jade), [Artisian](#/team/artisian) and [Round Loss Bonus](#/team/round-loss-bonus) 2-0 without dropping a map. In the final against [Cosmos](#/team/cosmos) they went 2-2 and lost the fifth map.

The Gigarage were consistent all year. At the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025) they won three group matches, two of them 13-0, before [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) stopped them. At the [BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025](#/tournament/BPLRR2025) they won five of seven and finished eighth.

An 11-5 record.

"Six maps in a row without losing one, then three lost in the one series that mattered," YoJareddo said. "That's a Major final for you."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #16 xJavyz
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[xJavyz](#/player/xjavyz) was #18 on our 2024 list, and in 2025 he climbs two places with another strong year for [entity](#/team/entity).

At the [BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025](#/tournament/BPLRR2025), entity won six of seven maps and finished second. They beat [Sacred Raven](#/team/sacred-raven) 19-17 in overtime, [Neverland](#/team/neverland), DiamondOnes and [Masmark](#/team/masmark) 13-7 each, [Aeternum](#/team/aeternum) and [Caelum Scala](#/team/caelum-scala). A 9-4 record from the Malaysian rifler.

"Second place hurts more than third," xJavyz said. "Ask anyone who has been there."

articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[caturteer](#/player/caturteer) spent the start of 2025 with Looking4Team and finished it in a Major semifinal.

After a 30th-place finish at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025), she joined [Round Loss Bonus](#/team/round-loss-bonus). A 12-9 record and an IGL who turned a new team into a Major semifinalist in her first year with it.

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #18 VPLH
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
At the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025) in March, [New Jade](#/team/new-jade) lost all four of their matches and finished 34th. In October they were champions again, and [VPLH](#/player/vplh) called every round of it.

Their spring and summer were rough: 34th at the Audax, 21st at the [BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025](#/tournament/BPLRR2025), and a group-stage exit at the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLCStage25). Then came the [BPL Legends Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLLStage25).

New Jade won six of seven maps. They beat [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) 13-6, Team Neverseen, Raven Song 13-0, [The Nomads](#/team/the-nomads) 13-10, Vitrix E-Sports 13-11 and [Round Loss Bonus](#/team/round-loss-bonus) 13-4. Their only loss was to [Aetherline](#/team/aetherline).

It was the IGL's second Legends title, three years after she led New Jade to the [BPL Legends Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLLegendsStage) crown. She was #4 on our list that year. She is back in 2025.

"Everyone wrote us off after March," VPLH said. "We've done this before. We know how it ends."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #19 SashimiGoesBloop
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
In March, [SashimiGoesBloop](#/player/sashimigoesbloop) was playing for a team called Looking4Team. In October he was a champion.

Looking4Team did what their name suggested at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025): they won one map in four and finished 30th. Seven months later he lined up with [Moonlit Tempo](#/team/moonlit-tempo) at the [BPL Challengers Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLChalS2025).

Moonlit Tempo won six of their seven maps. They beat Paper Tigers, The Weekend Bois and Sugarcrash Protocol, edged Aurum Core 13-11, beat [Round Loss Bonus](#/team/round-loss-bonus) 13-9, and beat Vitrix E-Sports 13-5, the team that finished second. Only [Aetherline](#/team/aetherline) beat them.

It was the second title of his career, four years after his first, with [Aeternum](#/team/aeternum) at [BPL Tournament Minor 6](#/tournament/BotProLeague6) in 2021.

"Looking for a team in March, champion in October," SashimiGoesBloop said. "Good year to stop looking."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2025: #20 Xyrolizea
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
2025 had five big events and five different champions: PepegaX at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025](#/tournament/audax-esse-bpl-invitational-2025), [Alcheministry](#/team/alcheministry) at the [BPL Ranking Reshuffle 2025](#/tournament/BPLRR2025), [Moonlit Tempo](#/team/moonlit-tempo) at the [BPL Challengers Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLChalS2025), [New Jade](#/team/new-jade) at the [BPL Legends Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLLStage25), and [Cosmos](#/team/cosmos), for the first time ever, at the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2025](#/tournament/BPLCStage25). The BPL Top 20 Players of 2025 counts down the players behind them, one a day until New Year's Eve.

[Xyrolizea](#/player/xyrolizea) starts us off. The AWPer's [Masmark](#/team/masmark) team handed the Reshuffle champions their only loss of the event.

Alcheministry won six of seven maps at the Ranking Reshuffle. The one they lost was 2-13 to Masmark. Masmark finished fourth, with five wins, including 16-14 over [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) and 13-1 over [The Gigarage](#/team/the-gigarage), who went on to reach the Major final.

At the Audax Invitational in March, Masmark won all four group matches before PepegaX, the eventual champions, beat them in the quarterfinals. At the Major they swept [Moonlit Tempo](#/team/moonlit-tempo) and lost a three-map quarterfinal to [Aetherline](#/team/aetherline).

A 10-4 record across three big events.

"We beat the champions 13-2," Xyrolizea said. "That's the scoreline I want on my wall."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #1 simply_perezoso
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Lemon Tree](#/team/lemon-tree) won the Major. But the best player of 2024 was the rifler at the heart of [Neverland](#/team/neverland)'s return.

[simply_perezoso](#/player/simply-perezoso) was #9 on our 2020 list after Neverland's famous comeback at [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3). Four years later, with four of that title team still together, she was the player opponents feared most.

At the [BPL Legends Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLLStage24), Neverland won six of their seven maps and the title: [Bloom E-Sports](#/team/bloom-e-sports) 13-9, nihilism. 13-9, [The Nomads](#/team/the-nomads) 13-4, [New Jade](#/team/new-jade) 13-11, [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun) 13-8 and Bluebird 13-8. The only blemish was a 14-16 overtime loss to [entity](#/team/entity). At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLCStage24) they swept Bluebird and [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) 2-0 to reach the quarterfinals before [degree](#/team/degree) ended the run.

An 8-2 record, an S-Tier title and a Major quarterfinal, in a year with only three big events. When Neverland needed a round, they looked to her, and more often than not she delivered it.

"In 2020 I was the new kid on a team that got lucky," simply_perezoso said. "In 2024 nobody called it luck."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #2 Resent
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Resent](#/player/resent) called for [Neverland](#/team/neverland) when they won [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3) in 2020, coming back from a 2-16 opening loss. In 2024 he called them to the [BPL Legends Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLLStage24) title.

Four of the five players from that 2020 team were still together, and this time there was no comeback needed. Neverland won six of seven maps at the Legends Stage. They beat [Bloom E-Sports](#/team/bloom-e-sports), nihilism., [New Jade](#/team/new-jade), [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun) and Bluebird, and handed [The Nomads](#/team/the-nomads) their only loss, 13-4, in the match that decided the title. Their own only loss was a 14-16 overtime defeat to [entity](#/team/entity).

At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLCStage24) Neverland swept their first two series before [degree](#/team/degree) beat them in the quarterfinals.

An 8-2 record and the second title of his career, four years apart.

"In 2020 we won by never giving up," Resent said. "In 2024 we won by never giving anyone a chance."

articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
In August 2024, [rebebx](#/player/rebebx) finally lifted a trophy. Soon after, she disappeared.

The trophy came at the [BPL Challengers Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLChalS2024) with Kabar. They lost their opening match 11-13 to [Bloom E-Sports](#/team/bloom-e-sports) and then didn't lose again: six straight wins, including a 16-14 overtime escape against nihilism., to finish first. After four years and a long list of teams, the rifler who was #5 on our very first list in 2020 had a title of her own.

Then came the [BPL Legends Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLLStage24). Kabar lost 3-13 to [division20](#/team/division20), fought back to 2-2 with wins over [Opal](#/team/opal) and, in overtime, [Cyanide](#/team/cyanide), and then met [Masmark](#/team/masmark) with everything on the line. They lost 10-13. Three rounds from the next stage of her career.

She hasn't played since. Friends say she is still playing every day, offline, away from brackets. Whatever comes next, 2024 was the year rebebx proved she could win.

"I'll be back," she told us in a short message. "Not yet. But I'll be back."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #4 luminmochi
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[luminmochi](#/player/luminmochi) won the 2024 Major, and she did it the way great teams do: by winning the close ones first.

[Lemon Tree](#/team/lemon-tree) opened the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLCStage24) with three deciders in a row. [DiamondOnes](#/team/diamondones) 2-1. [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) 2-1. [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch), the #1 team in the BPL, 2-1 in the quarterfinals. Then, with the pressure off, they didn't lose another map: 2-0 over [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) and 3-0 over [degree](#/team/degree) in the final.

She is the highest-placed Lemon Tree player on this list, two years after the same team won the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022).

A 5-0 record and a Major.

"People kept asking when Lemon Tree would win again," luminmochi said. "We were just waiting for the biggest one."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #5 ostc.x
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[ostc.x](#/player/ostc-x) was on the [Neverland](#/team/neverland) team that won [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3) in 2020 after losing its first match. Four years later she is part of their best season since.

At the [BPL Legends Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLLStage24) Neverland went 6-1 and took the title. They beat [Bloom E-Sports](#/team/bloom-e-sports) and nihilism. 13-9, crushed [The Nomads](#/team/the-nomads) 13-4, edged [New Jade](#/team/new-jade) 13-11, and beat [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun) and Bluebird 13-8. Only [entity](#/team/entity) beat them, in overtime.

They also reached the Major quarterfinals at the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLCStage24), sweeping Bluebird and [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) before [degree](#/team/degree) stopped them.

An 8-2 record from one of the league's longest-serving riflers.

"We're the old team now," ostc.x said. "Old teams know how to close."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #6 Ice
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Ice](#/player/ice) gave [Neverland](#/team/neverland)'s veterans the one thing their 2020 title team didn't have: him.

The Malaysian rifler has been part of Neverland's line-up since at least 2022, and in 2024 the team finally won big again. At the [BPL Legends Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLLStage24) they took six of seven maps, including 13-4 over [The Nomads](#/team/the-nomads), who finished second. The only loss was a 14-16 overtime defeat to [entity](#/team/entity).

At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLCStage24) Neverland swept Bluebird and [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) 2-0 to reach the quarterfinals, where [degree](#/team/degree) ended their run.

An 8-2 year and an S-Tier title.

"Everyone talks about the four who were here in 2020," Ice said. "I'm the one who keeps them young."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #8 Meowcolmz
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Every call in [Lemon Tree](#/team/lemon-tree)'s perfect Major run came from [Meowcolmz](#/player/meowcolmz).

The [BPL Conquerors Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLCStage24) started with three straight deciders: [DiamondOnes](#/team/diamondones) 2-1, [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) 2-1, and then the big one, [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) 2-1 in the quarterfinals. The IGL kept his team calm through all three. After that Lemon Tree swept [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) 2-0 and [degree](#/team/degree) 3-0 to lift the trophy.

Five series, five wins, and a Major title for a team that has kept the same line-up since 2022.

"When you beat Aimpunch in a decider, the rest of the bracket gets quieter," Meowcolmz said. "We just had to not get loud ourselves."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #15 Mike
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Mike](#/player/mike) was #9 on this list in 2021. Three years later he is back, calling for an [entity](#/team/entity) team that refused to stay down.

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #17 VanixEvans
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[VanixEvans](#/player/vanixevans) called [degree](#/team/degree) to the final of the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLCStage24).

The run went through some of the best teams in the league. A 2-1 win over [Masmark](#/team/masmark) in the group stage. A 2-0 sweep of [Neverland](#/team/neverland), who went on to win the Legends Stage, in the quarterfinals. A 2-0 sweep of [99Lives](#/team/99lives) in the semifinals.

In the final, [Lemon Tree](#/team/lemon-tree) won 3-0. But for an IGL whose team arrived without much fanfare, a Major final is a statement.

degree played one event in 2024, and VanixEvans made it count: a 3-1 record and a silver medal at the biggest event of the year.

"We had a plan for every team we played," VanixEvans said. "Lemon Tree had a better one in the final. We'll fix that."
articles.src:
[[VanixEvans]] called [[degree]] to the final of the [[BPL Conquerors Stage 2024]].

The run went through some of the best teams in the league. A 2-1 win over [[Masmark]] in the group stage. A 2-0 sweep of [[Neverland]], who went on to win the Legends Stage, in the quarterfinals. A 2-0 sweep of [[99Lives]] in the semifinals.

In the final, [[Lemon Tree]] won 3-0. But for an IGL whose team arrived without much fanfare, a Major final is a statement.

degree played one event in 2024, and VanixEvans made it count: a 3-1 record and a silver medal at the biggest event of the year.

"We had a plan for every team we played," VanixEvans said. "Lemon Tree had a better one in the final. We'll fix that."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #18 xJavyz
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[xJavyz](#/player/xjavyz) was part of the comeback of the year, and the only team to beat the Legends champions.

At the [BPL Challengers Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLChalS2024), [entity](#/team/entity) lost their first three maps, two of them in overtime: 19-22 to [Aspire](#/team/aspire) and 17-19 to ZAK3. They won their last four, two of them 13-2, and finished sixth.

At the [BPL Legends Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLLStage24) they were a different team. Six wins from seven, including a 19-16 overtime win over [Artisian](#/team/artisian), 16-14 over [Neverland](#/team/neverland) and 16-12 over [New Jade](#/team/new-jade). Neverland won the event anyway, but entity were the only team that beat them. Third place.

The Malaysian rifler finished the year 11-5.

"We started the Challengers 0-3," xJavyz said. "We finished the Legends as the only team to beat the champions. That's a good year."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #19 TuxedoCat
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Nobody in the league won more series in 2024 than [TuxedoCat](#/player/tuxedocat). He finished tied for the most, with 12, all of them with [Aspire](#/team/aspire).

At the [BPL Challengers Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLChalS2024), Aspire won six of seven maps, starting with a 22-19 overtime win over [entity](#/team/entity) and finishing with a 13-11 win over [Bloom E-Sports](#/team/bloom-e-sports). Only a 3-13 loss to nihilism. blemished the run, and they finished second behind Kabar.

At the [BPL Legends Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLLStage24) they lost two of their first three, then won four straight, including 13-4 over nihilism. and 13-7 over [Artisian](#/team/artisian), to finish fifth. At the Major they beat Bloom E-Sports 2-1 before a three-map loss to [99Lives](#/team/99lives).

A 12-4 record from a rifler who barely had a bad day.

"Twelve wins and no trophy," TuxedoCat said. "I'd trade six of them for a final."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2024: #20 bluenerd8
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
2024 was a short year in the BPL: three big events, the [BPL Challengers Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLChalS2024), the [BPL Legends Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLLStage24) and the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2024](#/tournament/BPLCStage24), the year's Major. Every player on this year's list made their mark at one of them. The BPL Top 20 Players of 2024 starts today and runs to New Year's Eve.

[bluenerd8](#/player/bluenerd8) was the AWPer for [degree](#/team/degree), the surprise finalists of the Major.

degree opened with a 2-1 win over [Masmark](#/team/masmark) in the group stage, then swept [Neverland](#/team/neverland) 2-0 in the quarterfinals, a result that looks even better now that Neverland have won the Legends Stage. In the semifinal they swept [99Lives](#/team/99lives) 2-0. The final against [Lemon Tree](#/team/lemon-tree) was one-sided, 0-3, but nobody had expected degree to be there at all.

Three series wins, one loss, and a Major final.

"Nobody picked us," bluenerd8 said. "That's fine. We picked ourselves."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #1 Chiai Fujikawa
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
The best player of 2023 called for the best team the BPL has ever seen.

[Chiai Fujikawa](#/player/chiai-fujikawa) joined [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) in 2022 and won the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2022) in his first event with them. In 2023 he led them to a season nobody had come close to before.

The [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2023): [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) 2-0, [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) 2-1, [Ukiyo](#/team/ukiyo) 2-1, then [Opal](#/team/opal) twice, 3-1 in the winners' final and 4-3 in a seven-map grand final. The [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023), Aimpunch's first Major: [Masmark](#/team/masmark) 2-1, Fruit Basket 2-1, Bluebird 3-1 and Opal 3-2 in the final. The [Bot Pro Cup 2023](#/tournament/BotProCup2023): four straight wins, a 0-2 loss to [99Lives](#/team/99lives) in the winners' final, then degree 2-1 and 99Lives 3-1 in the grand final.

Three titles, one Major, fifteen series won and one lost. Aimpunch finished the year at the top of the BPL ranking, more than 900 points clear of Opal, and the Malaysian IGL was the voice behind all of it. Eight deciders went their way in those three events. That is not luck. That is calling.

"Everybody talks about our aim," Chiai Fujikawa said. "Ask them about the fifth map against Opal. That one was won on comms."

**The BPL Top 20 Players of 2023**

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #2 Sketch
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Sketch](#/player/sketch) was #10 on our 2020 list and #8 in 2022. In 2023, the year [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) became the best team in BPL history, he is #2.

The titles came one after another. The [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2023) in July, after a seven-map grand final against [Opal](#/team/opal). The [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023) in August, Aimpunch's first Major, after deciders against [Masmark](#/team/masmark), Fruit Basket and, in the final, Opal again. The [Bot Pro Cup 2023](#/tournament/BotProCup2023) in November, after a 0-2 winners' final loss to [99Lives](#/team/99lives) forced them to win two more series to lift the trophy.

Fifteen series won, one lost. The rifler is also the only player to make our list in three of the league's four years.

"The first title was in 2020, with three of the same players," Sketch said. "It took three years to be this good. I'd like to stay this good for three more."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #3 balililmao
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
In April 2020, [balililmao](#/player/balililmao) played in the first final in BPL history and lost it to [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch). In 2023, she won three titles as one of them.

She joined Aimpunch in 2022, and this was the year it all came together. They won the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2023) 4-3 in a seven-map grand final against [Opal](#/team/opal). They won the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023), the club's first Major, 3-2 against Opal. They won the [Bot Pro Cup 2023](#/tournament/BotProCup2023) after a trip through the losers bracket, beating [99Lives](#/team/99lives) 3-1 in the final.

She was #17 on our first list, in 2020, with Break the Circuit. Three years later, the rifler is #3 with a 15-1 record.

"I lost the first final to these guys," balililmao said. "Now I'm one of them. Funny how that works."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #4 [Idiot] AngelCrutcher
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
At the end of 2022, [AngelCrutcher](#/player/idiot-angelcrutcher) told us two losses kept him up at night: a five-map Bot Pro Cup final and a group-stage exit at the Major. In 2023 [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) won both of those events.

The [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023) came first. Aimpunch needed deciders against [Masmark](#/team/masmark) and Fruit Basket, beat Bluebird 3-1, and won a five-map final against [Opal](#/team/opal). Then, in November, they won the [Bot Pro Cup 2023](#/tournament/BotProCup2023), recovering from a winners' final loss to [99Lives](#/team/99lives) to beat degree 2-1 and 99Lives 3-1.

Add the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2023) in July and that is three titles, and a 15-1 record for an all-rounder who climbs from #14 to #4.

"Two bad memories, two trophies," AngelCrutcher said. "I sleep fine now."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #5 joyyy_cheng
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
A year ago [joyyy_cheng](#/player/joyyy-cheng) told us every road went through [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) and promised [Opal](#/team/opal) would find a way past them. In 2023 they got closer than anyone, twice.

At the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2023), the IGL took Opal to the winners' final, then through [Ukiyo](#/team/ukiyo) 3-0 in the losers final and into a seven-map grand final against Aimpunch. They lost 3-4. A month later, at the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023), they won three straight deciders and reached the Major final. They lost 2-3.

Two finals, decided by one map each. joyyy_cheng climbs from #16 to #5 because no team played Aimpunch closer in the biggest finals of the year.

"I said we'd find a way past them," joyyy_cheng said. "We found the door. We just couldn't get it open."

articles.body:

Two second places, a third place and 20 series wins.

"We beat Aimpunch 2-0," y1jingg said. "I'm going to keep saying that for a while."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #8 Scorpium
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Scorpium](#/player/scorpium) was in two grand finals in 2023. Three of [Opal](#/team/opal)'s five series losses all year came against one team.

That team was [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch). At the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2023) they beat Opal 3-1 in the winners' final and 4-3 in the grand final. At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023) they beat them 3-2 in the Major final.

Against everyone else, Opal were formidable. They beat [New Jade](#/team/new-jade), [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) and [Neverland](#/team/neverland) at the Audax, swept [Ukiyo](#/team/ukiyo) 3-0 in the losers final, and won three straight deciders at the Major, including a five-map semifinal against Ukiyo.

The Malaysian finished the year 9-5 and two maps short of two titles.

"Aimpunch are the measuring stick," Scorpium said. "We're the closest anyone has come to it. That's not nothing."

articles.body:
[Seireiix](#/player/seireiix) and [Opal](#/team/opal) had their moment of revenge in 2023. It came in the losers final at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2023).

[Ukiyo](#/team/ukiyo) had been the surprise of the event. Opal met them with a place in the grand final at stake and won 3-0, without dropping a map. That set up a rematch with [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch), who had beaten Opal 3-1 in the winners' final. The grand final went seven maps and Aimpunch won it 4-3.

At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023) the same two teams met again in the final, and again it went the distance: 3-2 to Aimpunch.

Two finals, two silver medals, and a 9-5 record for the AWPer.

"We swept Ukiyo, then took Aimpunch to seven maps," Seireiix said. "That's the best CS I've ever played, and we didn't win anything."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #10 lumi.nyaa
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[lumi.nyaa](#/player/lumi-nyaa) played in two grand finals against [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) in 2023 and took them to the last map both times.

At the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2023), [Opal](#/team/opal) swept [Neverland](#/team/neverland) 2-0 in the semifinals, lost the winners' final to Aimpunch, came back through [Ukiyo](#/team/ukiyo) 3-0, and lost a seven-map grand final 3-4.

At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023) Opal won three straight deciders: 2-1 over degree, 2-1 over [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer), and 3-2 over Ukiyo in a semifinal that went the full five maps. Then they lost the Major final 2-3.

Nine series wins across three events, and few players have come closer to winning a Major without doing it.

"Every map against Aimpunch felt like a final," lumi.nyaa said. "Then we played two actual finals against them. It didn't get easier."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #11 yumezukiyomi
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Only one player in the league won more series in 2023 than [yumezukiyomi](#/player/yumezukiyomi), and her [0v3](#/team/0v3) team spent the whole year in the business end of brackets.

They reached the grand final of [Bot Pro League Minor 11](#/tournament/BotProLeague11) and lost it 2-3 to [The Nomads](#/team/the-nomads). They won [Bot Pro League Minor 12](#/tournament/BotProLeague12) from the losers bracket, five straight wins and a 3-1 grand final over Polkadotters. They finished second at the [BPL Legends Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLLStage23) after winning their first five maps.

At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023) they beat [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) 2-1 and reached the quarterfinals. At the [Bot Pro Cup 2023](#/tournament/BotProCup2023) they won three times and finished ninth.

A 20-9 record, three top-two finishes and a title.

"People ask what our secret is," yumezukiyomi said. "We just never stop playing. Somebody has to get tired, and it's never us."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #12 capplecrow
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
In 2021 [capplecrow](#/player/capplecrow) told us [Aeternum](#/team/aeternum) were the only team his team couldn't solve, and promised he would be ready next time. In 2023 he called his team to a title.

[Sacred Raven](#/team/sacred-raven) won the [BPL Challengers Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCStage23) with six straight wins to open the event, including two 16-14 finishes against Murder of the Universe and [The Gigarage](#/team/the-gigarage). They followed it with sixth at the [BPL Legends Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLLStage23), beating Cyanide, [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun), Warlords and [Caelum Scala](#/team/caelum-scala).

The rest of the year was harder, with early exits at [Bot Pro League Minor 11](#/tournament/BotProLeague11), the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023) and the [Bot Pro Cup 2023](#/tournament/BotProCup2023), and eighth place with From The Ashes at [Bot Pro League Minor 12](#/tournament/BotProLeague12). But the trophy was the one thing missing from his career, and now it isn't.

A 13-11 record and a first title as an IGL.

"Took me three years," capplecrow said. "Worth the wait."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #13 gigichiii_
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[gigichiii_](#/player/gigichiii) called [The Gigarage](#/team/the-gigarage) to the only perfect title run of 2023's big events.

At the [BPL Legends Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLLStage23), The Gigarage won all six of their maps: Team Neverseen 16-6, [Caelum Scala](#/team/caelum-scala) 16-8, [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) 16-2, PepegaX 16-6, [Masmark](#/team/masmark) 16-14 and [Lemon Tree](#/team/lemon-tree) 16-11. Champions without dropping a map.

The Australian IGL's year built up to it. Lost Pavilion finished 11th at [Bot Pro League Minor 11](#/tournament/BotProLeague11), and Rats reached the semifinals of [Bot Pro League Minor 12](#/tournament/BotProLeague12). The Gigarage were fifth at the [BPL Challengers Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCStage23) before their Legends title, and 16th at the [Bot Pro Cup 2023](#/tournament/BotProCup2023).

A 15-9 record and a flawless trophy.

"Six maps, six wins," gigichiii_ said. "I didn't want anyone to have a reason to doubt it."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #14 kuro_mi
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[kuro_mi](#/player/kuro-mi) played in two of the closest finals in BPL history, both against [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch), and lost both by one map.

At the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2023), [Opal](#/team/opal) beat [New Jade](#/team/new-jade), [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) and [Neverland](#/team/neverland) to reach the winners' final, where Aimpunch won 3-1. Opal swept [Ukiyo](#/team/ukiyo) 3-0 in the losers final and got their rematch. The grand final went seven maps. Aimpunch won the last one.

A month later at the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023), Opal beat degree, [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) and Ukiyo, all in deciders, to reach the Major final. Aimpunch won it 3-2.

A 9-5 record. Two maps the other way and it would have been two titles.

"We lost two finals by a combined two maps," kuro_mi said. "I don't know if that's encouraging or cruel. Probably both."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #15 nattyuwus
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[nattyuwus](#/player/nattyuwus) played three events in 2023. Two of them ended in third place at the biggest tournaments of the year.

Her [Ukiyo](#/team/ukiyo) team opened the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2023) with a 16-14 win over [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) in qualifying. They beat Cyanide and Bluebird to reach the semifinals, lost a three-map semifinal to [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch), and then beat [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) 2-0 and Bluebird 3-2 before [Opal](#/team/opal) stopped them.

At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023) they reached the semifinals again, this time after wins over DiamondOnes and [Neverland](#/team/neverland). The semifinal against Opal went five maps. Ukiyo lost it 2-3.

A 7-5 record and two medals at the year's biggest events.

"Two third places in a row," nattyuwus said. "Next time I want the other kind of medal."

articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[zenn1sm](#/player/zenn1sm) was part of the [0v3](#/team/0v3) team that played more big matches in 2023 than almost anyone.

They opened the year with a run to the grand final of [Bot Pro League Minor 11](#/tournament/BotProLeague11), beating HydroHomies twice along the way, and lost a five-map final to [The Nomads](#/team/the-nomads), 2-3. They won [Bot Pro League Minor 12](#/tournament/BotProLeague12) after a quarterfinal loss, with five straight losers bracket wins and a 3-1 grand final.

At the [BPL Legends Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLLStage23) they won five maps in a row, including 16-3 over [Masmark](#/team/masmark) and 16-4 over [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable), before DiamondOnes beat them, and finished second. At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023) they beat [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) 2-1 in the group stage and reached the quarterfinals.

20 series wins, tied for second most in the league.

"We were never the favourites," zenn1sm said. "We were the team nobody wanted to draw."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #17 Kai
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Kai](#/player/kai) was on our list in 2021, calling for five different teams. He returns in 2023 with one team and two of the deepest runs of the year.

At the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2023](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2023), his [Ukiyo](#/team/ukiyo) team beat [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) 16-14 to qualify, then won through the group and swept Bluebird in the quarterfinals before [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) won the semifinal 2-1. From the losers bracket Ukiyo beat [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) 2-0 and Bluebird 3-2, and lost the losers final to [Opal](#/team/opal). Third.

A month later at the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2023) they did it again: [DiamondOnes](#/team/diamondones) 2-0, [Neverland](#/team/neverland) 2-1, and then a five-map semifinal against Opal that went the distance and went Opal's way. Third at the Major.

The year ended with a hard landing, two quick losses at the [Bot Pro Cup 2023](#/tournament/BotProCup2023). But two third places at the biggest events of the year are why he is here.

"Twice we were one series from a final," Kai said. "That hurts more than losing early."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #18 Wellson111
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Wellson111](#/player/wellson111) won a title in 2023, a few months after his team went out of a Minor without winning a map.

At [Bot Pro League Minor 11](#/tournament/BotProLeague11) his Alias team lost their opener 13-16 to [The Nomads](#/team/the-nomads), then won four straight in the losers bracket, including 16-1 and 16-2 wins, to finish fourth. At [Bot Pro League Minor 12](#/tournament/BotProLeague12) his Aeons team went out without winning a map.

Then he joined [Sacred Raven](#/team/sacred-raven). At the [BPL Challengers Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLCStage23) they won their first six maps, including 16-14 thrillers against Murder of the Universe and [The Gigarage](#/team/the-gigarage), and took the title. At the [BPL Legends Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLLStage23) they finished sixth with four wins from seven.

A 15-11 record and a trophy in his first event with a new team.

"After Minor 12 I thought about taking a break," Wellson111 said. "I'm glad I didn't."

An 8-5 record across three events, and a Major semifinal.

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2023: #20 Pearlim
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
If one team owned 2023, it was [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch), and you will meet all five of their players before this countdown is done. But the year belonged to plenty of others too, and the BPL Top 20 Players of 2023 starts with one of them. One player a day until New Year's Eve.

[Pearlim](#/player/pearlim) played six events with [0v3](#/team/0v3) and finished in the top two three times.

The best of them came at [Bot Pro League Minor 12](#/tournament/BotProLeague12). A 14-16 quarterfinal loss to Polar Star sent 0v3 to the losers bracket, and they won five straight: Royal Flush, Devil's Don't Die, Rats 2-0, Revolution 2-1 and Helix Strong 2-0. In the grand final they beat Polkadotters 3-1. Earlier in the year they had lost a five-map grand final to [The Nomads](#/team/the-nomads) at [Bot Pro League Minor 11](#/tournament/BotProLeague11), and in August they finished second at the [BPL Legends Stage 2023](#/tournament/BPLLStage23) after winning their first five maps.

A 20-9 record, one of the best in the league, and a title.

"Three top-two finishes in a year is a lot of pressure," Pearlim said. "I'd do it again tomorrow."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #1 SanCtuary
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) won the Major. [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) won two titles. But the best player of 2022 called for [Artisian](#/team/artisian), and it wasn't close.

[SanCtuary](#/player/sanctuary) played four events in 2022 and his team finished in the top seven of all four. At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022), the league's first Major, Artisian beat [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) 2-0 and Team Neverseen 2-1 to reach the semifinals. A week later they won the [BPL Challengers Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLChallengerStage), losing one map in ten. They followed it with third place at the [BPL Legends Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLLegendsStage) and seventh at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2022), where they took Aimpunch to three maps and then won two more series.

A 17-6 record, a title, a Major semifinal, and an IGL who made a team of five strong individuals into the most consistent line-up in the league. Opponents knew what Artisian would try. They just couldn't stop it.

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #2 Skyllabtw
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
In 2021, [Skyllabtw](#/player/skyllabtw) told us the one thing she hadn't ticked off her list was a trophy. In 2022 she got one, and climbed from #6 to #2.

It came with [Artisian](#/team/artisian) at the [BPL Challengers Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLChallengerStage), where they won nine of ten maps against a field of 20 teams. It was the high point of a year in which Artisian never finished outside the top seven of a big event: fourth at the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022), champions at the Challengers Stage, third at the [BPL Legends Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLLegendsStage), and seventh at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2022).

She tied for the most series wins in the league, 18, and only an early exit with Winter Solistice at the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022) stopped her year from being spotless.

"I said I wanted a trophy," Skyllabtw said. "I didn't say I'd stop at one."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #3 Historia
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
A year ago [Historia](#/player/historia) was #17 on this list, a champion who had only played half a season. In 2022 he played a full one, and won the biggest title the BPL had ever handed out.

[Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) won the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022), the league's first Major. They beat Bluebird and [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun) 2-1, [New Jade](#/team/new-jade) 3-1 in the semifinals, and [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) 4-3 in a final that went to the seventh map. The title took Infernum to #1 in the BPL ranking for the first time.

Around it, Infernum finished 13th at the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022), sixth at the [BPL Major SRR](#/tournament/BPLSRR), and 13th at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2022). A 12-10 record that will be remembered for one weekend.

Historia can play any role. In the Major final, Infernum needed him in all of them.

"Two years, two titles, both by the skin of our teeth," Historia said. "I'm starting to think that's just how we do it."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #4 VPLH
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[VPLH](#/player/vplh) called for the team of the spring.

[New Jade](#/team/new-jade) reached the semifinals of the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022) after sweeping [Lemon Tree](#/team/lemon-tree) and Fruit Basket 2-0, then lost to the eventual champions [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports). They finished fourth at the [BPL Challengers Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLChallengerStage), winning six of their nine maps.

At the [BPL Legends Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLLegendsStage) they put it all together. New Jade won six of seven maps, including 16-3 against Bluebird, 16-7 against [Artisian](#/team/artisian) and 16-8 against [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable), and took the title.

"Three events in three weeks," VPLH said. "By the third one, we didn't have to talk much. Everybody already knew the call."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #5 rebellioniite
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
No player in the league won more series in 2022 than [rebellioniite](#/player/rebellioniite). She finished tied for the most, with 18.

Her year began with Cyclone at the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022), where they won their opener and then met [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch), who won 16-11. She joined [Artisian](#/team/artisian) next, and from then on her teams were always near the top.

At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022), Artisian reached the semifinals. At the [BPL Challengers Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLChallengerStage) they won the title, losing only one map out of ten. At the [BPL Legends Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLLegendsStage) they finished third with wins over Fruit Basket and Cyanide. At the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2022) they met Aimpunch again, lost 1-2, and won two more series before finishing seventh.

An 18-8 record and a title for one of the league's sharpest riflers.

"Aimpunch beat me in March and again in August," rebellioniite said. "I've been keeping count. We're close."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #6 KTenshi
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[KTenshi](#/player/ktenshi) started 2022 with a 17-19 overtime loss and an early exit. He finished it with a trophy and four top-seven finishes.

The first event was the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022) with Glory, who lost 3-16 to [Syzygy](#/team/syzygy) and 17-19 to Aspect and finished 27th. Then he joined [Artisian](#/team/artisian).

Fourth at the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022), after wins over [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) and Team Neverseen. A 17-8 record with one of the deepest rifle line-ups in the league.

"Glory taught me what losing feels like," KTenshi said. "Artisian taught me how to stop."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #7 Elfy Mint
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
In 2021, [Elfy Mint](#/player/elfy-mint) played one event and won it without dropping a series. In 2022 she played five and learned how hard the BPL had become.

Her [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) team's year had one huge peak. At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022), they knocked out [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) in the group stage, beat [Neverland](#/team/neverland) 2-0 and [Artisian](#/team/artisian) 3-1, and took [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) to a seventh map in the first Major final in league history. They lost it 3-4.

Elsewhere the results were mixed: 12th at the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022), 11th at the [BPL Major SRR](#/tournament/BPLSRR), 8th at the [BPL Legends Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLLegendsStage), 14th at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2022). A 12-15 record, and a climb from #15 to #7 on this list because the AWPer was at her best when the stakes were highest.

"Last year I didn't lose," Elfy Mint said. "This year I lost a lot, and one of those losses was the best thing I've ever been part of."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #8 Sketch
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Sketch](#/player/sketch) won two titles and reached a third final in 2022. He tied for the most series wins in the league, 18, and lost only three.

With [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch), he went 18-3. They finished second at the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022) after a five-map grand final against [Lemon Tree](#/team/lemon-tree), won the [BPL Major SRR](#/tournament/BPLSRR) with nine straight maps after an opening loss, and won the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2022) with five straight series, including two wins over [Neverland](#/team/neverland), 3-2 and 4-2.

That Audax title put Aimpunch back at #1 in the BPL ranking.

The Major is the one that got away: a 1-2 group-stage loss to [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) at the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022). Sketch was #10 on our 2020 list. Two years later he is two places higher.

"Two titles is a good year," Sketch said. "Two titles and a Major would have been a great one."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #9 Illus
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
The win that shook up the first Major was called by [Illus](#/player/illus).

[Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) met [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) in the group stage of the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022). Aimpunch had just won the [BPL Major SRR](#/tournament/BPLSRR) and were the best team in the league. Kiedz won 2-1 and sent them home.

They didn't stop. A 2-0 over [Neverland](#/team/neverland), a 3-1 over [Artisian](#/team/artisian), and a final against [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) that went to a seventh map. Infernum won it, but the American IGL had led an outsider to within one map of the first Major title.

The rest of Kiedz's year was harder, with finishes of 8th to 14th in four other events and a 12-15 record overall. The Major run is the reason he is here, and it is reason enough.

"Beating Aimpunch told us the plan worked," Illus said. "The final told us how much further it can go."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #12 xmeijixx
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[xmeijixx](#/player/xmeijixx) was #4 on our 2020 list as [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch)'s IGL. In 2022 she called them to another title, and then left.

The year started with a final. At the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022), Aimpunch beat Cyclone, Rise of the Finches, [Opal](#/team/opal) 2-0 and [Lemon Tree](#/team/lemon-tree) 2-1, then lost a five-map grand final to Lemon Tree 2-3. Three weeks later they won the [BPL Major SRR](#/tournament/BPLSRR), recovering from an opening loss to win nine maps in a row.

At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022) they went out in the group stage to [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz). By the autumn she was calling for Iterum E-Sports, who finished 12th at [Bot Pro League Minor 10](#/tournament/BotProLeague10).

A 14-5 record and one more title with the team she helped build, before she moved on.

"Aimpunch will always be the team that made me," xmeijixx said. "But I wanted to find out what I could build somewhere else."

A 14-5 record and one more title with the team she helped build, before she moved on.

"Aimpunch will always be the team that made me," xmeijixx said. "But I wanted to find out what I could build somewhere else."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #13 Kairi
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Kairi](#/player/kairi), one of two Americans on [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz), nearly left the BPL's first Major as a champion.

[Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) were the story of the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022). They beat [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) 2-1 in the group stage, which sent the newly crowned SRR champions home. They swept [Neverland](#/team/neverland) 2-0 in the quarterfinals. They beat [Artisian](#/team/artisian) 3-1 in the semifinals. Then they took [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) to the seventh map of the final before losing 3-4.

Kairi can play any role, and Kiedz used him in all of them. The rest of the year brought 12th at the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022), 11th at the [BPL Major SRR](#/tournament/BPLSRR), 8th at the [BPL Legends Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLLegendsStage) and 14th at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2022), for a 12-15 record overall.

"Nobody expected us in that final," Kairi said. "Next time they will."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #14 [Idiot] AngelCrutcher
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[AngelCrutcher](#/player/idiot-angelcrutcher) went 18-3 with [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) in 2022, tied for the most series wins in the league, and won two titles.

The first was the [BPL Major SRR](#/tournament/BPLSRR), a single round robin of one-map matches. Aimpunch lost the opening round 7-16 to Raven Song, then won nine in a row, finishing with a 16-7 win over [Opal](#/team/opal) in the last round to take the title.

The second was the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2022) in August: [Artisian](#/team/artisian) 2-1, Fruit Basket 2-0, Opal 2-1, then [Neverland](#/team/neverland) twice, 3-2 in the winners' final and 4-2 in the grand final.

The other losses were a 2-3 grand final against [Lemon Tree](#/team/lemon-tree) at the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022) and a 1-2 group-stage exit against [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) at the Major. An all-rounder on the team with the most titles of the year.

"Three losses all year," AngelCrutcher said. "Two of them still keep me up at night. Guess which two."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #15 Dirfun
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Dirfun](#/player/dirfun) did his part in the biggest win of 2022, and plenty of smaller ones along the way.

At the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022), his [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) team opened with a 16-14 win over [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable). At the [BPL Major SRR](#/tournament/BPLSRR) they beat [Neverland](#/team/neverland) and Fruit Basket and finished sixth.

Then came the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022). Infernum won three-map series against Bluebird and [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun), beat [New Jade](#/team/new-jade) 3-1 in the semifinal, and won the seven-map final against [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) 4-3. The first Major in BPL history, and the title that took Infernum to #1 in the BPL ranking.

A 12-10 record and a Major title.

"People will remember the final," Dirfun said. "I'll remember the quarterfinal. Setting Sun nearly ended it all there."
