articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #16 joyyy_cheng
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[joyyy_cheng](#/player/joyyy-cheng) won more series in 2022 than most champions did. The only thing she couldn't do was beat [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) when it mattered.

Her [Opal](#/team/opal) team won 17 series across four events. At the [BPL Major SRR](#/tournament/BPLSRR) they won eight of their nine maps, beating [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) 16-3 and [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) 16-8, and went into the final round needing a win. Aimpunch won that map 16-7, and the title.

At the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022), Opal finished fourth after Aimpunch beat them 2-0 in the semifinal. At the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2022) they finished third, after Aimpunch beat them 2-1 in the semifinal, then won two more series before [Neverland](#/team/neverland) ended the run.

A 17-6 record. Three of the six losses were to one team.

"Every road went through Aimpunch," joyyy_cheng said. "One day we'll find a way past them."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #17 chiyoriinn
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[chiyoriinn](#/player/chiyoriinn) was the AWPer on the first team to win a BPL Major.

[Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) came into the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022) off a sixth-place finish at the [BPL Major SRR](#/tournament/BPLSRR), where they had won five of eleven maps, including a 16-13 win over [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) in the last round. Three days later they met Kiedz again in the Major final and won 4-3.

The road there went through Bluebird and [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun), both 2-1, and [New Jade](#/team/new-jade) 3-1 in the semifinal.

Later in the year, at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2022), Infernum beat [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) 2-1 in the losers bracket before Cyanide ended their run. A 12-10 record and the most important title of the year.

"We beat Kiedz at the SRR, then again in the final," chiyoriinn said. "By the seventh map I think we knew them better than they knew themselves."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #18 zuann_
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[zuann_](#/player/zuann) spent a lot of 2022 playing one map at a time, and her [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) team won some big ones.

The [BPL Major SRR](#/tournament/BPLSRR) was a round robin of single maps, and Kiedz opened it by beating [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) 16-4 and [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) 16-10. At the [BPL Legends Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLLegendsStage) they edged Raven Song and Temperament 16-14 each and beat Unforgettable again, 16-8.

And then there was the Major. At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022), Kiedz beat [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch), [Neverland](#/team/neverland) and [Artisian](#/team/artisian) to reach the final, and lost a seven-map thriller to [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports).

A 12-15 record over five events and a Major final.

"We beat the best teams in the league on our good days," zuann_ said. "Next year I want more good days."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #19 siddnely
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Somebody had to make the calls in the longest final in BPL history. For [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports), that was [siddnely](#/player/siddnely).

At the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022), Infernum won three-map series against Bluebird and [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun), beat [New Jade](#/team/new-jade) 3-1 in the semifinals, and then faced [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) in a best-of-seven final. It went to the last map. Infernum won it, and with it the league's first Major.

Her year around the Major was uneven: 13th at the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022) after a 16-14 win over [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable), sixth at the [BPL Major SRR](#/tournament/BPLSRR) with five wins from eleven maps, and 13th at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2022). But no title in 2022 was bigger, and no IGL had to hold a team together for longer in a single final.

"After map six I told everyone to forget the score," siddnely said. "One map. That was the whole plan."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2022: #20 declaration__
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
2022 was the year the BPL grew up. The league held its first Major, the [BPL Conquerors Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLCONQ2022), alongside a run of S-Tier events, and the list that follows reflects it: almost every player on it went deep at one of the year's biggest events. Today we begin the countdown of the BPL Top 20 Players of 2022, one a day until New Year's Eve.

At #20 is [declaration__](#/player/declaration), the AWPer for a [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) team that came within one map of the first Major title.

Kiedz knocked [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) out in the group stage 2-1, swept [Neverland](#/team/neverland) 2-0 in the quarterfinals and beat [Artisian](#/team/artisian) 3-1 in the semifinals. The final against [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) went the full seven maps. Infernum won the last one, 4-3.

The rest of the year was a grind: 12th at the [Bot Pro Cup 2022](#/tournament/BotProCup2022), 11th at the [BPL Major SRR](#/tournament/BPLSRR), 8th at the [BPL Legends Stage 2022](#/tournament/BPLLegendsStage), 14th at the [Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2022](#/tournament/AuxEBPL2022). A 12-15 record that hides how close Kiedz came to history.

"Seven maps," declaration__ said. "I've replayed the seventh one more times than I've played it."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #1 chreyll
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
The best player of 2021 started the year without a winning team and finished it as a champion at the top of the BPL ranking.

[chreyll](#/player/chreyll) played five events in 2021. The first three were tough. Dark Matter lost a 16-19 overtime opener at [BPL Tournament Minor 5](#/tournament/BotProLeague5) and finished seventh. Team Elegy beat [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) 16-5 at [BPL Tournament Minor 6](#/tournament/BotProLeague6) and finished ninth. Starstruck went out early at [Bot Pro League Minor 7](#/tournament/BotProLeague7).

Then the AWPer joined [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer), and everything changed. At [Bot Pro League Minor 8](#/tournament/BotProLeague8) they beat Moonlite, Pacemaker, TacKTicK 2-1 and Fluff N' Stuff 2-0, and lost a three-map grand final to Unforgettable. At [Bot Pro League Minor 9](#/tournament/BotProLeague9) they were champions: IronSite, Team F&S and Shining Hearts, a 1-2 winners' final loss to [Syzygy](#/team/syzygy), then Shining Hearts again and a 2-0 sweep of Syzygy in the grand final.

That title made Divide&Conquer the third team ever to sit at #1 in the BPL ranking. chreyll was the player opponents feared most on the way there: a 13-8 year, two finals in the last two events, and the best AWP in the league when it mattered.

"At the start of the year I was just trying to win a map," chreyll said. "Now I'm trying to keep a crown."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #2 InfiniteBreaker
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Nobody in the BPL won more series in 2021 than [InfiniteBreaker](#/player/infinitebreaker). He finished the year 16-8.

His year turned at [Bot Pro League Minor 7](#/tournament/BotProLeague7) with FateChanger. After a first-round loss to The Setup they won five straight in the losers bracket, including a 16-0 over RadiaKnights and 2-0 wins over LGL and SussyBaka?, before a three-map loss to the eventual champions [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports). Third place.

Then came [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer). At [Bot Pro League Minor 8](#/tournament/BotProLeague8) they reached the grand final and lost 1-2 to [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable). At [Bot Pro League Minor 9](#/tournament/BotProLeague9) they won it, beating Shining Hearts twice and [Syzygy](#/team/syzygy) 2-0 in the grand final.

Three top-three finishes in the last three events of the year, with two different teams. He can play any role, and in 2021 he played all of them well.

"Sixteen wins," InfiniteBreaker said. "I didn't count them. I just remember the ones we lost."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #3 LITA
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[LITA](#/player/lita), the German rifler, played four events in 2021 and finished in the top three in three of them.

She started the year with [Syzygy](#/team/syzygy), who beat [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) 16-14 at [BPL Tournament Minor 6](#/tournament/BotProLeague6) and finished third. After a rough [Bot Pro League Minor 7](#/tournament/BotProLeague7), she moved to [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer).

What followed was the best two-event stretch of the year. At [Bot Pro League Minor 8](#/tournament/BotProLeague8) they won four straight and lost a three-map grand final to Unforgettable. At [Bot Pro League Minor 9](#/tournament/BotProLeague9) they lost the winners' final to her old team Syzygy, then beat Shining Hearts and swept Syzygy 2-0 in the grand final.

A 13-6 record, one of the best win rates on the list, and a title.

"Beating my old team in the final was strange for about five seconds," LITA said. "Then it was just great."

At [[Bot Pro League Minor 9]] they lost the winners' final to her old team Syzygy, then beat Shining Hearts and swept Syzygy 2-0 in the grand final.

A 13-6 record, one of the best win rates on the list, and a title.

"Beating my old team in the final was strange for about five seconds," LITA said. "Then it was just great."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #4 Solec
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
A year ago [Solec](#/player/solec) was #8 on this list after leading [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) to a final. This year he finally won one, three weeks after losing another final to his old team.

For most of 2021 nothing went right. Love&Stuff, NCL and Under Siege all finished outside the top ten. Then Solec took over the calling at [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer).

At [Bot Pro League Minor 8](#/tournament/BotProLeague8) they reached the grand final and met Unforgettable, his old team, who won it 2-1. At [Bot Pro League Minor 9](#/tournament/BotProLeague9) there was no mistake: after a 1-2 winners' final loss to [Syzygy](#/team/syzygy), Divide&Conquer beat Shining Hearts and then Syzygy 2-0 for the title. The win took them to the top of the BPL ranking.

From #8 to #4, and from runner-up to champion.

"I lost a final with Unforgettable last year and to them this year," Solec said. "The third final was the one I needed."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #6 Skyllabtw
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
No player in the league won more series in 2021 without lifting a trophy than [Skyllabtw](#/player/skyllabtw).

She went 14-10 across five events. The best of them was [BPL Tournament Minor 6](#/tournament/BotProLeague6) with From The Ashes, who reached the grand final through the losers bracket with wins over Trailblazers United, Ephemeral and Tidal Wave, before falling to an unbeaten [Aeternum](#/team/aeternum).

At [Bot Pro League Minor 9](#/tournament/BotProLeague9) she reached fourth with Shining Hearts, winning twice in the losers bracket before [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) ended it. Pacemaker, her team at [Bot Pro League Minor 8](#/tournament/BotProLeague8), beat T-Spin, who went on to finish third, before a 15-19 overtime loss to [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable).

A rifler who made every team she joined harder to beat.

"I've been close plenty of times this year," Skyllabtw said. "The trophy is the one thing on my list I haven't ticked."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #7 tanykeat
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[tanykeat](#/player/tanykeat) called for the only team to beat [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) at [Bot Pro League Minor 9](#/tournament/BotProLeague9).

[Syzygy](#/team/syzygy) beat Team Monsoon and Team NewSchl, edged L3gends 2-1 in the semifinal, and then beat Divide&Conquer 2-1 in the winners' final. Divide&Conquer came back through the losers bracket and won the grand final 2-0, but nobody else in the event beat them.

Earlier in the year, Syzygy finished third at [BPL Tournament Minor 6](#/tournament/BotProLeague6), beating [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) 16-14 and Luminescence 2-1 before Ephemeral ended their run.

Only three events, but two of them ended in the top three, and an 8-5 record.

"We beat the best team in the league," tanykeat said. "Then they beat us. Now we both know what it takes."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #8 Nifela
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Nifela](#/player/nifela) lost the first match of [Bot Pro League Minor 8](#/tournament/BotProLeague8) 7-16 and didn't lose again.

From the losers bracket, [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) beat Aegis, Behemoth and Pacemaker 19-15, then swept Pr1sm, Durendal and T-Spin 2-0. A 2-1 win over Fluff N' Stuff put them in the grand final, where they beat [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer) 2-1 for the title. Eight wins in a row from the bottom of the bracket, and the American IGL called every one.

His year had been building to it. Team Elegy reached ninth at [BPL Tournament Minor 6](#/tournament/BotProLeague6) with a 16-5 win over Unforgettable, the team he would later lead to a trophy, and Team Ragtag finished seventh at [Bot Pro League Minor 7](#/tournament/BotProLeague7) after a 16-0 win.

A 13-7 record and one of the great losers bracket runs of the year.

"After the first map we stopped thinking about the bracket," Nifela said. "We only thought about the next map. There were a lot of them."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #9 Mike
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Two third places with two different teams made [Mike](#/player/mike) one of the most consistent IGLs of 2021.

At [BPL Tournament Minor 5](#/tournament/BotProLeague5), RabbitLeap won four straight in the losers bracket after a quarterfinal loss to [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz). At [Bot Pro League Minor 7](#/tournament/BotProLeague7), FateChanger lost their first match 14-16 and then won five in a row, including a 16-0, before the eventual champions [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) won a three-map losers final.

He also took Arroast to fifth at [Bot Pro League Minor 9](#/tournament/BotProLeague9). After an opening loss they won three straight in the losers bracket: 19-17 over SpiderMonke, 16-1 over Syphon, and 25-23 over AuCrow in one of the longest maps of the year.

A 13-10 record and twelve losers bracket wins in three events.

"I don't plan for the lower bracket," Mike said. "I just seem to end up living there."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #10 y1jingg
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[y1jingg](#/player/y1jingg) spent a lot of 2021 in the losers bracket, and she made it pay.

At [Bot Pro League Minor 8](#/tournament/BotProLeague8), her T-Spin team lost their opener 9-16 to Pacemaker. They answered with four straight wins: Moonlite 16-14, Coarse Air, Heart of Cards 2-0 and TacKTicK 2-1. [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable), on their way to the title, ended it. Third place.

At [Bot Pro League Minor 9](#/tournament/BotProLeague9), Shining Hearts beat Ascension and AuCrow to reach the semifinal, lost to [Divide&Conquer](#/team/divide-conquer), then won twice more in the losers bracket before Divide&Conquer beat them again. Fourth. Earlier in the year, Luminescence reached fifth at [BPL Tournament Minor 6](#/tournament/BotProLeague6).

Three finishes in the top five, an 11-8 record, and a calling style that kept teams alive long after one loss.

"Losing early just means more games," y1jingg said. "More games means more chances to be right."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #11 lukedefabio
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[lukedefabio](#/player/lukedefabio) reached the first final of 2021 and lost it to a team that didn't lose a series all event.

His Trailblaze United team opened [BPL Tournament Minor 5](#/tournament/BotProLeague5) with wins over Team widepeepoHappy and BattleBuds, then swept Defiance 2-0 in the semifinal. [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) won the winners' final 2-1, but Trailblaze United came back, beating RabbitLeap 2-0 in the losers final to earn a rematch. Kiedz won the grand final 2-0.

At [Bot Pro League Minor 8](#/tournament/BotProLeague8) he was back in the top three with T-Spin. A first-round loss to Pacemaker sent them down, and they won four straight before [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) stopped them. Third.

Two top-three finishes, both as the IGL, and a 9-8 record overall.

"Kiedz beat us twice in one event," lukedefabio said. "That's the standard. We'll get there."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #12 Laburi
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Laburi](#/player/laburi) spent most of 2021 calling for teams that punched above their weight.

At [BPL Tournament Minor 5](#/tournament/BotProLeague5), RabbitLeap lost 7-16 to the eventual champions [Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) in the quarterfinals, then won four in a row in the losers bracket: Dark Matter, [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) 2-1, Defiance 2-1 and Sanctuary 2-0. Trailblaze United ended the run one step from the final. Third place.

At [Bot Pro League Minor 7](#/tournament/BotProLeague7), his St-Dreamteam beat Unforgettable 16-2 and [Syzygy](#/team/syzygy) 16-10 in the losers bracket on the way to sixth. The rest of his year brought tougher results with Ryhope, Behemoth and AuCrow, the last ending in a 23-25 overtime defeat.

A 9-10 record with five teams, and a reputation as an IGL who gets the most out of any line-up.

"Give me five players and a week," Laburi said. "We'll beat someone we're not supposed to."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #15 Elfy Mint
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Elfy Mint](#/player/elfy-mint) played one event in 2021. She won every series of it.

[Kiedz](#/team/kiedz) took [BPL Tournament Minor 5](#/tournament/BotProLeague5) with a perfect 5-0 run. Royal Path and RabbitLeap fell in the opening rounds, then Sanctuary 2-1 in the semifinal. In the winners' final they beat Trailblaze United 2-1, and when Trailblaze United came back through the losers bracket, Kiedz beat them again, 2-0, in the grand final.

Only two teams went unbeaten through an event in 2021, and Kiedz were the first. A single event keeps the AWPer from climbing higher on a list built on the whole year, but nobody can say she lost.

"One event, one trophy, no losses," Elfy Mint said. "I don't know how to improve on that, except by doing it more often."

articles.body:
[Historia](#/player/historia) played two events in 2021 and won one of them in the hardest way possible.

At [Bot Pro League Minor 7](#/tournament/BotProLeague7), [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports) lost their first match 12-16 to LGL. Then they won seven in a row in the losers bracket: Nitro Hearts, cAps lOckEd 19-15 in overtime, From The Ashes, The Setup and ZoBros 2-0, and then two 2-1 deciders against FateChanger and Audax Esse. In the grand final they beat Fluff N' Stuff 2-1.

Eight straight wins after an opening loss, and Infernum's first title.

His only other event, with Team widepeepoHappy at [BPL Tournament Minor 5](#/tournament/BotProLeague5), ended in two quick losses. That's how an 8-3 player with a trophy finishes 17th: the Top 20 rewards a full year, and Historia's was half of one.

"After the LGL loss, nobody panicked," Historia said. "We'd lost one map. We had the whole bracket to fix it."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #18 Kai
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Kai](#/player/kai) called for five teams in 2021, and two of them made deep runs.

The best was FateChanger at [Bot Pro League Minor 7](#/tournament/BotProLeague7). A 14-16 loss to The Setup in the first round sent them straight to the losers bracket, and they went on a tear: Under Siege, Senior J-Cubed, a 16-0 over RadiaKnights, then LGL and SussyBaka? both 2-0. Only [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports), who went on to win the event, beat them, 2-1. Third place.

Earlier in the year, Luminescence finished fifth at [BPL Tournament Minor 6](#/tournament/BotProLeague6) after beating Gothic Storm and Sonder before a three-map loss to [Syzygy](#/team/syzygy). At [Bot Pro League Minor 8](#/tournament/BotProLeague8), Heart of Cards won two 16-14 thrillers in a row.

A 10-10 record with five different line-ups, and a third place built on the IGL's calls.

"A 16-0 in the losers bracket," Kai said. "That's the map I'd show anyone who asks what FateChanger was."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #19 lilraxxx
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Two fourth-place finishes in two months made [lilraxxx](#/player/lilraxxx) one of the most dependable AWPers of 2021.

The first came with Audax Esse at [Bot Pro League Minor 7](#/tournament/BotProLeague7). They beat cAps lOckEd 16-4 and LGL 16-3, swept ZoBros 2-0 in the semifinal, and took Fluff N' Stuff to three maps in the winners' final. [Infernum E-Sports](#/team/infernum-e-sports), in the middle of their title run, ended it 2-1.

A month later at [Bot Pro League Minor 8](#/tournament/BotProLeague8) he was with Pr1sm. They lost their opener 13-16 to Pacemaker, then won three straight in the losers bracket before [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable), the eventual champions, stopped them.

Add fifth place with BattleBuds at [BPL Tournament Minor 5](#/tournament/BotProLeague5), where they beat PixIgnite 2-1 before Sanctuary ended it, and the year comes to 10-10.

"Fourth twice is annoying," lilraxxx said. "It also means we were close twice. I'll take close over nowhere."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2021: #20 skysbeautylai
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
The BPL Top 20 Players of 2021 starts today. Five Minors, five different champions, and three of those titles won by teams that lost a match along the way and came back through the losers bracket. Over the next twenty days we count down the players who made it happen, ending with the #1 on New Year's Eve.

First up is one of only two players returning from last year's list. [skysbeautylai](#/player/skysbeautylai) was #13 in 2020, and this year she was part of From The Ashes' run to a grand final.

At [BPL Tournament Minor 6](#/tournament/BotProLeague6) they beat NCL and Sonder before a 1-2 semifinal loss to [Aeternum](#/team/aeternum). From the losers bracket they then beat Trailblazers United 2-0, Ephemeral 2-1 and Tidal Wave 2-0 to reach the grand final, where Aeternum won again.

The rest of the year was quieter: 17th with Whiteout, 13th with From The Ashes at [Bot Pro League Minor 7](#/tournament/BotProLeague7), 16th with Black Rabbits, then seventh with Team NewSchl at [Bot Pro League Minor 9](#/tournament/BotProLeague9), where they won two in the losers bracket. A 9-10 record and a second straight year in the Top 20.

"Two years on the list means I'm not a one-week wonder," skysbeautylai said, smiling.

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #1 y.uuno
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
The best player of 2020 never lifted a trophy, and nobody on the list deserves the top spot more.

[y.uuno](#/player/y-uuno) was the AWPer for Break the Circuit at [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1). After a 23-25 overtime loss to Dropdead, they won three straight series in the losers bracket, including a 2-0 revenge over Dropdead, to reach the league's first-ever final. [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) won it.

After eighth place with Knights of Ni at [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2), she joined Time2Tap and the results came fast. Fourth at [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3), after beating Fullburst, SkyHigh and TeamRGB to reach the winners' final. Third at [BPL Tournament Minor 4](#/tournament/BotProLeague4), after four straight wins in the losers bracket.

Three top-four finishes with two teams and a 14-8 record. Trophies will come. In 2020, y.uuno was simply the best player in the BPL.

"I don't care about the order of names on a list," y.uuno said. "But I'll take this one."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #2 rach.elx_
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[rach.elx_](#/player/rach-elx) was the only player in the league to finish in the top five at all four Minors of 2020, and nobody won more series than her 15.

At [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1) she reached fourth with Counter League after three straight wins in the losers bracket. At [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2) she was part of [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable)'s five-series losers bracket run to the grand final. At [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3), Nextg3n beat [Neverland](#/team/neverland) 16-2 and 2Bit4 16-1 before finishing fifth. At [BPL Tournament Minor 4](#/tournament/BotProLeague4), Birds of Prey won the winners' final against [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun) and reached another grand final.

The one thing missing is a trophy: both finals ended in 0-2 defeats. But no player was as reliably near the top as rach.elx_, with four teams and four strong results.

"Second place twice is a nice problem to have," she said. "I'd still swap both of them for one first."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #3 jaelyo
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Few players in 2020 were as hard to stop on a good day as [jaelyo](#/player/jaelyo).

At [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3), her Nextg3n team beat [Neverland](#/team/neverland) 16-2 and 2Bit4 16-1 in their first two matches. Neverland went on to win the event, and Nextg3n were the only team to beat them all tournament. [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) ended the run in the semifinals.

The trophy came at [BPL Tournament Minor 4](#/tournament/BotProLeague4) with [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun). They beat CasualGaming and Pixinite, won a three-map semifinal over [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable), lost the winners' final 1-2 to Birds of Prey, beat Time2Tap 2-1, and then won the grand final rematch 2-0.

Add sixth place with Vamprix at [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1) and the year comes to 10-7 with a title.

"At Minor 3 we beat the eventual champions 16-2," jaelyo said. "At Minor 4 we made sure we were the champions."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #4 xmeijixx
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
The first team to win a BPL event was called by [xmeijixx](#/player/xmeijixx).

[Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) took [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1) without losing a series. They beat ZeroTempo, TeamSolid and Vamprix, survived a three-map semifinal against Dropdead, and beat Break the Circuit 2-0 in the final.

At [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3) she led them through four more wins, including a 2-0 over Nextg3n and a 2-1 over Time2Tap, and into another final. [Neverland](#/team/neverland) won it 2-1 after their run through the losers bracket.

Aimpunch played two of the four Minors and went 9-1. As the player making the calls on the best team of the year, xmeijixx is the highest-ranked Aimpunch player on this list.

"We set the standard at Minor 1," xmeijixx said. "Everyone has been chasing it since, and so have we."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #5 rebebx
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
For two events, nothing went right for [rebebx](#/player/rebebx). For the next two, almost everything did.

She lost both her matches with ZeroTempo at [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1) and both with Methelic at [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2). Four matches, four losses.

Then she joined Time2Tap. At [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3) they beat Fullburst, SkyHigh and TeamRGB to reach the winners' final, lost it 1-2 to [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch), and lost a three-map losers final to [Neverland](#/team/neverland). Fourth place. At [BPL Tournament Minor 4](#/tournament/BotProLeague4) they went further still: a quarterfinal loss to Destined, then four straight wins over CasualGaming, Veracity ESports, [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) and Pixinite, before [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun) won the losers final 2-1. Third place.

Her 7-8 record hides the shape of the year. From May on, rebebx was one of the most dangerous riflers in the league.

"The first two events I barely won a round that mattered," rebebx said. "Then Time2Tap gave me a home."

articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[okjustsmd](#/player/okjustsmd) started 2020 by losing 0-16. She ended it with two final appearances.

That opening came with 12Punch against TeamRNG at [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1). 12Punch recovered to win two series and finish eighth.

Two finals with two different teams, and a 13-7 record.

"We started the year losing 0-16," okjustsmd said. "Two finals later, I'd call that progress."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #7 Ziweiv
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Three different teams, three top-four finishes. Nobody was more adaptable in 2020 than [Ziweiv](#/player/ziweiv).

She started at [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1) with Break the Circuit, who came back from a 23-25 overtime loss to reach the league's first final. At [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3) she was with 2Bit4: a 1-16 loss to Nextg3n in the quarterfinals, then wins over Zyaxis, PrettySus and TeamRGB before [Neverland](#/team/neverland) ended the run 2-1 in the losers final. Third place.

At [BPL Tournament Minor 4](#/tournament/BotProLeague4) she joined Pixinite and finished fourth, with 2-0 wins over Flickception and Destined along the way. Only a ninth place with Zero7 at [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2) broke the pattern.

A 13-8 record from a player who fills whatever role her team needs.

"Give me whatever role is left," Ziweiv said. "I'll make it work."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #8 Solec
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
The best losers bracket run of the spring was called by [Solec](#/player/solec).

At [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2), [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) lost to Selectfire in the second round. From there they beat WR4TH, Knights of Ni and 6-Down, then [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) 2-1 and Eclipse 2-0, five straight series to reach the grand final. [Fruit Basket](#/team/fruit-basket) won it 2-0, but Unforgettable's run was the story of the event.

Solec's year also took in seventh place with Bloodlust at [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1), an early exit with UpNComers at [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3), and fourth place with Pixinite at [BPL Tournament Minor 4](#/tournament/BotProLeague4), where they won three straight in the losers bracket before Time2Tap ended it.

An 11-8 record and a final from the IGL's chair.

"In the lower bracket every call has to be right," Solec said. "We made five series' worth of right calls in a row."

[simply_perezoso](#/player/simply-perezoso) lost her first match of [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3) by fourteen rounds and won the tournament anyway.

Her year began quietly, with a two-loss exit with Reflex Storm at [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1). At [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2), Selectfire beat Midknight and then [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable), the eventual finalists, before a 16-19 overtime loss to Eclipse and a 1-2 defeat by [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch).

Then came [Neverland](#/team/neverland). A 2-16 opener against Nextg3n sent them to the losers bracket, and they never lost again: MixTrix, TBreezy, SkyHigh, Nextg3n, 2Bit4 and Time2Tap, before a 2-1 grand final win over Aimpunch.

A 9-5 record and a title in the most dramatic run of the year.

"We lost our first map by fourteen rounds and won the whole thing," simply_perezoso said. "I still don't fully believe it."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #10 Sketch
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
When the BPL crowned its first champion, [Sketch](#/player/sketch) was holding a rifle for them.

[Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) won [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1) without losing a series: ZeroTempo, TeamSolid and Vamprix, then Dropdead 2-1 in the semifinal and Break the Circuit 2-0 in the final.

At [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3) they nearly did it again. Four more wins, including a 2-0 over Nextg3n and a 2-1 over Time2Tap, put them in the grand final, where [Neverland](#/team/neverland) won 2-1.

Sketch and Aimpunch played only two Minors in 2020, which costs them on a list built on the whole year. A 9-1 record says enough about the two they did play.

"People call us the first champions," Sketch said. "I'd rather be remembered as the best ones."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #11 plainyingying
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[plainyingying](#/player/plainyingying)'s case is about quality more than trophies.

She finished fourth with Counter League at [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1), winning three straight in the losers bracket, two of them 16-14, before Break the Circuit ended the run. At [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2) she reached the semifinals with Eclipse, who beat Selectfire 19-16 in overtime on the way and lost a three-map semifinal to [Fruit Basket](#/team/fruit-basket).

Fullburst and Tempo brought shorter runs at the last two Minors. Tempo's exit at [BPL Tournament Minor 4](#/tournament/BotProLeague4) came after a 15-19 overtime loss to [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable).

An 8-8 record does not do her rifle justice. Two top-four finishes in the league's first week do.

"I want the trophies to catch up with the aim," plainyingying said.

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #12 adrina.ii
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[adrina.ii](#/player/adrina-ii) played in the first final in BPL history, and lost it. By May she had a trophy of her own.

At [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1) she was the AWPer for Break the Circuit, who survived a 23-25 overtime loss to Dropdead and fought back through the losers bracket to reach the final, where [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) won 2-0.

After an early exit with Juggerknot at [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2), she joined [Neverland](#/team/neverland) for [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3). They lost their first match 2-16, then won seven series in a row, the last four all 2-1, ending with Aimpunch in the grand final.

Two finals from three events and a 13-5 series record.

"I played in the first final and lost it," adrina.ii said. "Winning one less than two weeks later felt like closing a loop."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #13 skysbeautylai
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
In the space of one week, [skysbeautylai](#/player/skysbeautylai) learned how fast the BPL moves.

At [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2) she was part of the [Fruit Basket](#/team/fruit-basket) team that went five for five: WR4TH, [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) 16-11, 6-Down, Eclipse 2-1 in the semifinal, then [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) 2-0 in the grand final. Only the second champion in league history.

Seven days later, at [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3), the same team lost to TBreezy and Zyaxis and finished 16th.

Her other two events brought tenth place with AllKnights at [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1) and ninth with Tempo at [BPL Tournament Minor 4](#/tournament/BotProLeague4), where a 15-19 overtime loss to Unforgettable stood between them and the semifinals. A 7-6 record, with the title as its centrepiece.

"We were champions for one week," skysbeautylai said, "and we learned how fast that feeling goes."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #14 Leveti
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
For three Minors, [Leveti](#/player/leveti) went home early. At the fourth, he went home with the trophy.

His year began with TeamSolid at [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1) (11th), continued with Ironsight at [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2) (13th), and then TBreezy at [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3) (12th). There were flashes along the way: TBreezy beat the reigning champions [Fruit Basket](#/team/fruit-basket) 16-11 in the first round.

Then he took over the calling for [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun). At [BPL Tournament Minor 4](#/tournament/BotProLeague4) they won their first three series, lost the winners' final 1-2 to Birds of Prey, beat Time2Tap 2-1 to get back to the final, and won the rematch 2-0. Champions of the year's last event.

A 7-7 record looks ordinary. The way it ended does not.

"Three early exits. I kept notes on every one of them," Leveti said. "Setting Sun got the benefit."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #15 yuuki_PS
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[yuuki_PS](#/player/yuuki-ps) lost one series in 2020. One.

She played two events with [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) and went 9-1. At [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1) they won the league's first-ever title: ZeroTempo, TeamSolid and Vamprix in the opening rounds, a 2-1 semifinal against Dropdead, and a 2-0 final against Break the Circuit.

At [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3) they went four for four again, including a 2-0 semifinal over Nextg3n and a 2-1 winners' final over Time2Tap. Only [Neverland](#/team/neverland), coming all the way through the losers bracket, stopped them, 1-2 in the grand final.

Playing two Minors instead of four keeps her lower on this list than her record deserves. A 9-1 record speaks for itself.

"Nine wins and one loss," yuuki_PS said, "and the loss is the one I think about."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #16 zhiweiingg
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
If 2020 had an overtime specialist, it was [zhiweiingg](#/player/zhiweiingg).

Her Dropdead team opened [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1) with three straight overtime wins: 19-17 over Just4Fun, 19-16 over TeamRNG and 25-23 over Break the Circuit in the longest map of the year. They then pushed [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) to three maps in the semifinal before going out in fifth.

Midknight and EasySqueezy brought early exits at the next two Minors. Then came [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun) at [BPL Tournament Minor 4](#/tournament/BotProLeague4). They beat CasualGaming and Pixinite, edged [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) 2-1 in the semifinal, and lost the winners' final 1-2 to Birds of Prey. From the losers bracket they beat Time2Tap 2-1, then won the grand final rematch 2-0. The last trophy of the year was theirs.

A 9-7 record and a title for zhiweiingg.

"Overtime is where I feel most awake," she said. "Everyone else gets nervous. I get comfortable."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #17 balililmao
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
The longest map of 2020 had [balililmao](#/player/balililmao) in it, and her team lost it.

At [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1), Break the Circuit went down 23-25 to Dropdead in an overtime marathon. Instead of folding, they won their next three series in the losers bracket: Counter League 16-13, 2Out 2-0 and then Dropdead again, 2-0. That put them in the league's first-ever final, where [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) won 2-0.

She followed it with third place with Eclipse at [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2), beating Methelic, Zero7 and Selectfire before a 1-2 semifinal loss to [Fruit Basket](#/team/fruit-basket). A seventh-place finish with SkyHigh at [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3) and an early exit with Viscosity at [BPL Tournament Minor 4](#/tournament/BotProLeague4) rounded out a 10-8 year.

Two top-three finishes in the league's first two events made balililmao one of 2020's early faces.

"That 23-25 still hurts," she said. "Beating them 2-0 in the rematch helped a little."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #18 S.GT
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Only one player in this year's Top 20 won more series than [S.GT](#/player/s-gt). She finished 2020 with 14 wins, and the best of them came in a run nobody saw coming.

At [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3), [Neverland](#/team/neverland) lost their opening match 2-16 to Nextg3n. From the losers bracket they then beat MixTrix, TBreezy and SkyHigh, took revenge on Nextg3n 2-1, beat 2Bit4 2-1 and Time2Tap 2-1, and finished it with a 2-1 win over [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch) in the grand final. Seven straight series after a 2-16.

S.GT's year also included seventh place with Bloodlust at [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1), fifth with Neverland at [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2), and a run to fourth with Pixinite at [BPL Tournament Minor 4](#/tournament/BotProLeague4), where they won three straight in the losers bracket before Time2Tap stopped them.

"After the 2-16 we had nothing left to lose," S.GT said. "That made us dangerous."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #19 Phxebe
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
[Phxebe](#/player/phxebe) owns a small piece of history: she was part of only the second team ever to win a BPL event.

That was [Fruit Basket](#/team/fruit-basket) at [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2), and they did it without dropping a series. WR4TH, then a 16-11 win over [Aimpunch](#/team/aimpunch), the league's first champions, then 6-Down 16-13. A 2-1 semifinal against Eclipse followed, and a clean 2-0 over [Unforgettable](#/team/unforgettable) in the grand final.

The rest of the year was harder. At [BPL Tournament Minor 1](#/tournament/BotProLeague1) her Vamprix team won its first two matches before losing 12-16 to Aimpunch and 14-16 to 2Out. The title defence at [BPL Tournament Minor 3](#/tournament/BotProLeague3) lasted two maps, ending in 16th place.

Still, a 7-4 record and a trophy put the AWPer on the list.

"Beating Aimpunch in the bracket told us we belonged," Phxebe said. "The final was just the proof."

articles.title: Top 20 Players of 2020: #20 zhizyii
articles.author: BPL Staff
articles.body:
Welcome to the BPL Top 20 Players of 2020. Over the next twenty days we count down the best players of the league's first year, one a day, ending with the #1 on New Year's Eve. The list weighs what each player's teams achieved across the four Minors of 2020 together with how well each player played.

We start with the most travelled player of the year. [zhizyii](#/player/zhizyii) played all four Minors, each time with a different team: TeamRNG, Eclipse, Detoxify and Birds of Prey.

The results improved as the year went on. With Eclipse at [BPL Tournament Minor 2](#/tournament/BotProLeague2) she reached the semifinals on the back of a 19-16 overtime win over Selectfire, then took [Fruit Basket](#/team/fruit-basket) to a third map before falling 1-2. At [BPL Tournament Minor 4](#/tournament/BotProLeague4), Birds of Prey beat [Setting Sun](#/team/setting-sun) 2-1 in the winners' final and reached the grand final, where the rematch went 0-2 the other way.

A 9-7 series record and a runner-up finish earn zhizyii the first spot on the list.

"Every new team was a new language on comms," she said. "By June I could call for anyone. Next year I want to call for one team the whole way."

tournaments.name: BPL Conquerors Stage 2026
tournaments.formatNote: 32 teams: the top 16 of the BPL rankings and the 16 Legends Stage qualifiers. 4 Swiss groups of 8 (4 direct invites and 4 Legends qualifiers in each), 5 rounds. The top 2 of each group go to an 8-team playoff. The groups are drawn once the Legends Stage ends.

tournaments.name: BPL Legends Stage 2026
tournaments.formatNote: 48 teams: the pro teams ranked #17–49 and the top 15 of the Challengers Stage. 4 Swiss groups of 12, 5 rounds. The top 4 of each group (16 teams) qualify for the Conquerors Stage. The groups are drawn once the Challengers Stage ends.
